maria: I'm handing off the night shift. Quick summary below — TL;DR: two issues, one mitigated, one monitoring.

maria: INCIDENT A - embed-ingest-queue spike :rotating_light:
- Started ~22:10 UTC, sudden backlog in embed workers (~10x).
- Mitigation: scaled worker ASG + disabled prefetch on the ingest service.
- Observed KV cache churn in traces (k/v hit rate dropped).
- Current status: backlog draining, ingestion rate ~70% of normal, still watching.
- Next steps: revert the prefetch change only if backlog stabilizes; otherwise keep scaled for 2h.

maria: commands I ran:
```bash
# scale down/up workers
kubectl -n redwood autoscale deployment embed-worker --min=2 --max=24
# temporarily disable prefetch flag in config map
kubectl -n redwood set env deploy/ingest-service PREFETCH=false
```

oncall-bot: Alert: embed-ingest-queue backlog recovered to 1.2k -> 420 in 18m. (link: https://metrics.redwood.company/d/ingest)

jake: Good catch, Maria. Do we have any regression from the rollouts tonight? which deploy bumped this?

maria: It lines up with the 21:55 deploy to ingest-service (hash 4f2b). I rolled it back to 4e9a for now. No user-facing errors reported.

lee: I pushed a small patch to reduce prefetch concurrency in the feature branch earlier today — PR #487. cc @sophia for review. If that patch lands we'll make the change permanent.

sophia: I can take a look in 20m. quick heads-up: there's also a failing test in the CI for quota-checks that might block the PR merge.

maria: INCIDENT B - host-gpu-temp-warning :warning:
- Alert triggered for a single host in gpu-pool-3 hitting 88C on memory temps. Fan curve bumped automatically.
- Mitigation: moved two pods off the host to other nodes, cordoned host for investigation.
- Current status: thermal stabilized, node marked unschedulable.
- Next steps: hardware team to run diagnostics in AM; I'll attach serial logs to the ticket. Ticket: INF-2026.

arjun: Noted. There's a scheduled maintenance on us-west-2 starting 01:30 UTC for kernel patches — I'll coordinate the drain so it doesn't overlap with night traffic.

jake: Quick ping: I still have PR #492 in review blocking a small bugfix for cache eviction. Can someone from runtime take a look? cc @lee @arjun

lee: I'll do a quick pass before I grab dinner. If it's trivial I'll merge and cut a canary.

sophia: Also FYI, customer-replay job for acct-998 will run at 03:00 UTC. It's high IO but we've throttled concurrency. Might see a small latency bump in embeddings during that window.

maria: Handoff checklist:
- All active alerts: embed-ingest (watch), host-gpu (investigating).
- Runbooks used: ingest-queue-runbook v2.1, gpu-thermal-runbook v1.0.
- Outstanding follow-ups: attach serial logs to INF-2026, keep embed ASG scaled for 2h, monitor prefix cache hit rate.

oncall-bot: Reminder: oncall rotation tonight -> @arjun (00:00-08:00 UTC).

arjun: I'll take over at midnight. Leaving my mobile in case of pager.

maria: Thanks team — leaving now. If anything regresses, escalate to SRE channel and ping me for context. :white_check_mark:

jake: Thanks Maria, good handoff. I'll triage the cache PR and follow up in-thread.

lee: copied. Will post merge/rollback notes here if I touch the canary.

sophia: On CI flake — I'll rerun the failing job and post results.

arjun: Taking over. Good luck, night crew.
